column1: RQ3 replication package — verified transfer targets

column2: 1,160 verified transfer targets (reproduced client breakages) for the 32 breaking dependency updates whose OpenCode/GPT-5.4-mini/JavaParser fixing transformation is used as RQ3 seed (first run that is an RQ1 compilable rule, passes RQ2 3/3 mvn test, and is a pure AST rewrite).
2026-04-21 to 2026-10-20 (original capped code search and unmerged-PR search in April–May 2026; size-sharded code search and all-PR history search 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-20).
No filter on creation date, activity date, stars, size, archival status or forks. One candidate per (repository, breaking update).

A candidate is a transfer target if it builds with the old version and, after bumping to the new version, fails with the same broken API elements as the seed (mvn clean test-compile, fresh container).

FIXED = mvn clean test-compile succeeds after applying the seed transformation unchanged; NO_MATCH = rule ran without error but changed no file; INCOMPLETE_MIGRATION = rule rewrote code but the client still fails to compile; TRANSFORMATION_ERROR = rule execution failed.
For FIXED clients: PASS / FAIL of `mvn clean test` after re-applying the same transformation (NA otherwise).
Client commit that was checked out (base commit for PR-found targets, HEAD at search time for code-search targets).
First search that produced the candidate: code search (original, capped), code search (size-sharded), unmerged PR search, all-PR history search.
